notes: The You're locked in for box now gives each event its own row when a booking covers several dates, so the venue and the times sit beside the date they belong to instead of one Venue row that was only ever the first one. A row reads Thu 19 Nov - Printworks - 22:00-04:00, and says venue to be confirmed or times to be confirmed for whatever hasn't come back yet. If the nights have different artists the name goes in the row too. One event at one venue is unchanged.
